# use-gesture vanilla

Pinned @use-gesture/vanilla 10.3.1 with bundled @use-gesture/core, MIT licensed.
Self-contained ESM bundle downloaded from:
https://esm.sh/@use-gesture/vanilla@10.3.1/es2022/vanilla.bundle.mjs

License: https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@use-gesture/vanilla@10.3.1/LICENSE
Core carries the same MIT license. No runtime CDN requests are needed.
Documentation: https://use-gesture.netlify.app/docs/

Used by work.js for folder drag tracking, axis locking, swipe recognition and
tap filtering. The site owns the paper artwork, settling and project selection.
Keep the version pinned and rerun touch, cancellation and keyboard checks when
upgrading. The vanilla API is labelled experimental by upstream.
